newsitem.title: USA: Southern 822 MW nuke seen in startup Friday.
newsitem.headline: Southern 822 MW nuke seen in startup Friday.

text.p: Southern Nuclear Operating Co's 822 megawatt Farley nuclear power unit 2 was expected to begin the startup process Friday afternoon and synchronize to the power grid this weekend, a company spokeswoman said.
"We're still looking at beginning startup later today," spokeswoman Loretto Stevens said Friday.
The unit, in Dothan, Ala., was shut Oct 12 for scheduled refueling and maintenance.
The 812 megawatt Farley nuclear power unit 1 continued to operate at full power.
Southern Nuclear is a subsidiary of Southern Co.
